code:
# /etc/cron.d/pg-maintenance
{{schedule}} postgres psql -d {{db_name}} -c 'VACUUM (ANALYZE, VERBOSE);' >> /var/log/pg-vacuum.log 2>&1
# 週日凌晨 3 點 reindex 重型表
0 3 * * 0 postgres psql -d {{db_name}} -c 'REINDEX TABLE CONCURRENTLY public.events;' >> /var/log/pg-reindex.log 2>&1
summary_zh: crontab 排 vacuum/analyze 與週末 reindex
